problem: ClickHouse would not start on the Pi 5
symptom: jemalloc: unsupported system page size
root_cause: Pi 5 kernel uses 16 KB pages; ClickHouse's ARM build needs 4 KB
fix: kernel=kernel8.img in /boot/firmware/config.txt

problem: DBeaver could not read query results
symptom: Invalid LZ4 magic byte: '-112'
root_cause: server answered ZSTD (0x90) and JDBC driver 0.9.5 expected LZ4 (0x82)
fix: driver property compress=false

problem: ClickHouse cannot consume from RabbitMQ's amq.topic directly
symptom: clients may not declare reserved amq.* exchanges
root_cause: RabbitMQ reserves the amq. prefix
fix: pre-create a durable queue bound to amq.topic; rabbitmq_queue_consume=1

problem: producer looked healthy while sending nothing
symptom: 'Connected' printed on a refused login; every reading printed even if unsent
root_cause: on_connect ignored the reason code; publish loop ignored connection state
fix: check reason code, exit on auth failure, count broker acks
evidence: wrong-password test exits with 'Bad user name or password'

problem: stored tables stayed empty after install
symptom: refresh jobs succeeded but inserted 0 rows
root_cause: min() over an empty DateTime column returns 1970-01-01; minus 20 min wraps to 2106
fix: minOrNull + coalesce
evidence: stored 26-42 rows within a minute after fix

problem: documented machine re-rating command failed
symptom: Cannot UPDATE key column upd_tmstmp
root_cause: ReplacingMergeTree version column cannot be updated
fix: ReplacingMergeTree without a version column
evidence: SCD2 test: new version current, old gets valid_to

problem: setup.sh corrupted or skipped passwords
symptom: '&' replaced by matched text; empty password exited silently
root_cause: bash 5.2 patsub_replacement; ':-' treats empty as unset and read fails without a TTY
fix: shopt -u patsub_replacement; test '+set'

problem: producer crashed on Windows
symptom: AttributeError: SIGUSR1
root_cause: signal.SIGUSR1 does not exist on Windows
fix: register only if present

problem: dashboard showed 0 producers while 6 were running
symptom: Producers tile 0, machine list 6
root_cause: active = readings timestamped in the last 60 s; readings arrived ~90 s late
fix: count machines by arrival time (inserted_at)

problem: 20-80% of readings lost with 6 producers
symptom: seq gaps from 19:44; RabbitMQ connections 'blocked'
root_cause: dashboard queries starved ClickHouse -> slow consumer -> RabbitMQ flow control -> 20k-message producer buffer full -> publish refused, return code ignored
fix: fixes 11-15 below + producer drop reporting and 5-min buffer

problem: live spectrogram cost 43% of ClickHouse CPU
symptom: 4.3 s CPU per dashboard read
root_cause: ClickHouse has no FFT: pure-SQL DFT is ~15.5 M trig-multiplies per machine-minute, ~800x slower than numpy FFT
fix: executable UDF stft_db: the original numpy code, RowBinary I/O, persistent process

problem: anomaly view cost 1.2-2.5 s per query
symptom: dominant cost after the UDF (51.5 CPU-s)
root_cause: ClickHouse re-runs a WITH subquery at every reference; the live health calculation ran ~5x per query
fix: baseline from stored minutes, median and MAD from arrays in one pass; live view read once

problem: dashboard re-derived minute values every 5 s
symptom: health and anomaly queried 22-28 times per 2.5 min
root_cause: one refresh cadence for data that changes at three speeds
fix: tiers: 5 s / 10 s / 30 s
evidence: 5 runs instead of 28 for the slow tier

problem: summary query cost grew with retention
symptom: 435 ms, 11 M rows read every 5 s
root_cause: uniqExact(machine) scanned the whole raw table
fix: count/max from part metadata; machine count from machine_hlp

problem: late minutes for one machine never stored
symptom: spectrogram backfill stuck at 126 of 366 minutes
root_cause: one high-water mark shared by all machines
fix: engine.fact_minutes arrival summary: per-machine, per-minute to-do list

problem: a stored minute froze if more readings arrived later
symptom: (design risk, found in review)
root_cause: minutes were stored once and never revisited
fix: recalculate when fact_minutes count > stored sample_count

problem: test readings copied into the live queue
symptom: 1,440,300 messages in clickhouse_engine
root_cause: RabbitMQ topic routing copies each message to every bound queue; a live queue was recreated during a load test
fix: purge; run load tests on a separate topic

problem: 12-29% loss and ~48 s delay at 6 producers after the dashboard fixes
symptom: 4-5 of 6 MQTT connections 'blocked'; ~400 readings/s per machine; gaps of ~100 readings
root_cause: RabbitMQ QoS 1 confirmations ~1.4 s under load x 500 unconfirmed messages per paho connection -> ~400 msg/s ceiling; 20,000-message producer buffer full -> drops
fix: 50 readings per MQTT message + 10,000 in-flight window (both producers, DuckDB ingest decoder)
evidence: probe: 300 msgs confirmed in 1.46 s; after fix 20,000/20,000 at exactly 500/s

problem: ClickHouse CPU understated
symptom: system.events counter showed ~11% of a core; process was 110-140%
root_cause: OSCPUVirtualTimeMicroseconds covers query threads only; RabbitMQ engine threads not included
fix: measure process CPU from /proc (sysmon.py); relabel earlier figures as query CPU

problem: dashboard rate and delay misleading
symptom: 421/430 rows/s shown at 500/s; 2.0 s delay shown vs ~0.5 s real
root_cause: incomplete first/last 10-s buckets averaged as full; producer t0 truncated to the second; laptop clock ~0.75 s behind
fix: average complete buckets only; producer starts on the next whole second; sync laptop to the Pi (chrony)
evidence: min sent->received 757 ms vs a few ms expected

problem: orphaned RabbitMQ table looping
symptom: 24,385 log lines/min from iot.accel_queue
root_cause: its queue had been deleted; the engine restarts its loop ~75 times/s
fix: database iot dropped (not needed)
